summary: This bill directs the Surgeon General to study the impact of mobile device use in elementary and secondary schools and establishes a pilot program to award grants to schools to create environments free of mobile devices by purchasing secure storage containers.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly impacts public schools by authorizing grants for local educational agencies to create mobile-device-free environments and by directing a study on mobile device use in schools. The funding is specifically for public elementary and secondary schools, which constitutes increased spending on public schools.
